Subject: Re: Hosted pricing for high-volume token ingestion

Elliot — thanks for the detailed sample. Looping in Ben and Marissa for pricing and structured commit options.

High level we can do the following for hosted API customers at that scale:

- Baseline: $0.0003 per input token / $0.0006 per output token for the curated high-throughput model family (example numbers; see attached RA_Ratecard_v2.pdf).
- Tier discounts:
  * 0 - 100M tokens: baseline
  * 100M - 500M: 10% discount off baseline
  * 500M - 1B: 20% discount off baseline
  * >1B: contact sales for custom pricing (typically 25-35% off depending on commit and duration)
- Reserved burst capacity and SLAs available with a 6- or 12-month reserved commit. We can include a 15% burst credit buffer for the first two months of a 12-month commit.

I attached a draft rate card and a quick blended-example for your CSV. Ben — can you confirm the blended bill example and whether we can push a 22% (vs 20%) concession for an annual 750M commit?

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-05-31 08:58:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pricing flexibility for STRM-042

Rafael — digging into the numbers from the sample: if they sustain ~750M tokens/month for 12 months we can structure as follows without margin erosion: 

- Annual commitment (12 mo) at 750M/month (9B tokens total)
  * Effective discount: 22% off baseline (gives them $0.000234 / in-token rate and $0.000468 / out-token)
  * Onboarding credit: $15k one-time credit applied to first invoice for evaluation/smoke tests
  * Burst buffer: +10% free burst for the first 60 days
  * Observatory retention: 90 days included; longer retention for a fee

Notes for negotiation: keep the >1B conversation open for a bespoke infra-contribution model (Dedicated). For hosted we should avoid sub-20% discounts at scale unless they lock for 12 months and provide a forecast cadence.

Marissa — please prepare a succinct one-page commercial summary to send to Elliot + procurement. Naomi — confirm whether we can include a clause for incremental price reviews at the 6-month mark tied to token mix variance.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Director, Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference
